newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul yields close higher on Hanbo default.
newsitem.headline: Seoul yields close higher on Hanbo default.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds closed higher on Friday as Hanbo's loan default freezed buying sentiment, dealers said.
Hanbo Steel failed to honour payments of more than five billion won on Thursday after facing financial trouble stemming from excessive facilities investment.
They said new issues were estimated at 37 billion won today.
The three-month CD yields and overnight call rates closed higher on fears of tightening liquidity after Hanbo's failure.
